greet.speaker: Settler (P)
greet.text: You're not from the coast villages. Farmer's hands, though. What do you want?

choices.text: I need a blade. Can you spare one?

place.speaker: Settler (P)
place.text: A few houses on the Coast Road, a day out of Sentinel. We keep the fire lit and the road clear. Mostly.

blade.speaker: Settler (P)
blade.text: Spare one? Steel costs. Give me a reason.

choices.text: [Speech 25] The road isn't clear. I can help keep it that way.

bladeYes.speaker: Settler (P)
bladeYes.text: Fair. Take it, and bring it back clean.

bladeNo.speaker: Settler (P)
bladeNo.text: Words are cheap on this road. No.
